label: A DSH adapter should send a JSON headless task over stdin with workspace-write and no interactive approval, scoped to a lineage cwd and supervised externally.
The runner must own timeout handling; DSH nonzero exit plus JSON final reason can serve as task failure evidence unlike Pi's noisy exit status.
Per-lineage DSH_HOME is the candidate real state boundary, but needs an explicit credential env allowlist or seeded profile contract; SPECKIT state markers alone are hints.
DSH should use shared recursion guards without Pi's self-presence exemption and only claim sandbox capability after workspace-write effects are verified.
The new mode touches the shared executor registry, runner, YAML workflows, council, dispatch classifiers, stress adapters, advisor graph/fixtures, generated triggers, and runtime manifests/docs.
